The scientific consensus is clear: **no link exists** between the MMR vaccine and autism.

Multiple large-scale epidemiological studies across thousands of children have found no connection (Taylor et al., 2014; Honein et al., 2001; Madsen et al., 2002). The original 1998 study that claimed a link was retracted, and its author lost his medical license after fraud was revealed. Major health organizations worldwide (WHO, CDC, NIH, AMA) all confirm the vaccine is safe.
